acceptance: A profile which requires user or mount namespaces installs them before runner code can parse an Artifact.
Kernel policy which makes the namespace adapter unavailable is reported as an isolation failure before execution.
The Linux adapter has focused supported-path and fail-closed coverage.
The example compiles, verifies, links explicit providers, executes with limits, and emits an execution report.
The same artifact is exercised with replaceable provider implementations.
The example documents its snapshot and artifact identity.
